QUOTE: "`archivedChannelsViewable = (value?: string) => value !== 'false'` (`app/queries/servers/system.ts:304`) returns `true` for `undefined`. ... Only an explicit `'false'` from older servers that still send it turns the feature off."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that an absent setting means archived channels are viewable and only an explicit 'false' disables them.
